title: How Much Is This? No New Signs
label: ch:mw-price-question
canDo: I can ask the price of one named thing and ask for the total at the end, at a shop counter, a food stall, or a rickshaw, using no Devanagari sign I have not already written.

payoff.summary: The asking word arrives by ear, joins two source-printed price questions that add no new sign, and the first of them is then run unchanged over a shopping word, a food word, and a transport word in four separately scored skills.
